children: was trading higher after an SEC filing showed that its 10% owner Berkshire Hathaway (
) has raised stake in the homebuilder.
Shares were 4.44% higher at $81.55 during morning trading on Tuesday.
Berkshire Hathaway acquired ~2.74M class A and B shares of Lennar in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $74.49 to $79.79.
Post the transactions, the investing behemoth owns ~23.72M class A shares of indirect ownership and 528,217 class B shares of indirect ownership.
The news comes after Warren Buffett, who has overseen Berkshire Hathaway (
) (BRK.A) for 61 years, stepped down as chairman.
